items.title: Met4All: a dockerised Shiny application for DNA methylation array analysis, visualization and reporting.
items.title_zh: Met4All：一个用于DNA甲基化阵列分析、可视化和报告的Docker化Shiny应用。
items.summary_zh: DNA甲基化谱分析广泛用于肿瘤分类、生物标志物发现和分子亚群识别。然而，Infinium甲基化阵列数据的常规分析通常需要结合多个R包和自定义脚本进行预处理、质量控制和下游解读。我们开发了Met4All（Methylation For All），一个Docker化Shiny应用，用于Infinium HumanMethylation450K、EPIC和EPIC v2阵列数据的集成分析。Met4All接受原始IDAT文件和预计算的beta矩阵，可在同一界面内实现端到端预处理或直接下游分析。它集成了自动质量控制、归一化、降维（MDS、PCA、UMAP）、共识热图、全局甲基化谱分析、两组差异甲基化分析、基因集富集测试和拷贝数分析。结构发现依赖无监督学习（UMAP结合基于图的社区检测，以及共识聚类）；未实现监督分类或基于模型的特征选择。输出可导出为出版级图表和表格，用于下游工作流。在与九种代表性工具

extra.description: DNA methylation profiling is widely used for tumour classification, biomarker discovery and the identification of molecular subgroups. However, routine analysis of Infinium methylation-array data typically requires combining multiple R packages and custom scripts for preprocessing, quality control and downstream interpretation. We developed Met4All (Methylation For All), a dockerised Shiny application for integrated analysis of Infinium HumanMethylation450K, EPIC and EPIC v2 array data. Met4All accepts both raw IDAT files and precomputed beta matrices, enabling either end-to-end preprocessing or direct downstream analysis within the same interface. It integrates automated quality control, normalisation, dimensionality reduction (MDS, PCA, UMAP), consensus heatmaps, global methylation profiling, two-group differential methylation analysis, gene-set enrichment testing and copy-number analysis. Structure discovery relies on unsupervised learning (UMAP with graph-based community detection, and consensus clustering); no supervised classification or model-based feature selection is implemented. Outputs are exportable as publication-ready plots and tables for use in downstream workflows. In a systematic comparison against nine representative tools, Met4All was the only one to make all 17 assessed criteria available within a single graphical interface, although individual criteria are supported by several of the frameworks compared. The framework has already supported published methylation studies and is illustrated here on independent public data. Met4All provides an accessible and reproducible environment for integrated methylation-array analysis without requiring extensive bioinformatics expertise. Met4All is implemented in R as a dockerised Shiny application. Source code, Docker configuration files and documentation are available at https://github.com/gcampof/Met4All, and the version described here is archived at Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23265674). Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: GapCNV: A comprehensive framework for CNV detection in low-input DNA sequencing data
items.title_zh: GapCNV：低输入DNA测序数据CNV检测的综合框架
items.summary_zh: 拷贝数变异（CNV）在二倍体和单倍体基因组中均普遍存在， contribute to genome evolution and phenotypic diversity。然而，由于读数浅且高度不均以及扩增偏差，低输入数据（包括低细胞和单细胞测序数据）中的CNV检测仍具挑战性。另一个挑战在于选择参考样本，其用于提供定义拷贝数丢失或获得的基线。使用含常见CNV的参考进行归一化可能导致真实CNV信号抵消或假CNV调用。在此，我们开发了GapCNV，一个用于单倍体和二倍体基因组低输入DNA测序数据CNV检测的统计框架。GapCNV利用初步细胞聚类和共享CNV谱，从推断为拷贝中性状态的细胞构建bin特异性伪参考。该策略减少了常见CNV纳入归一化基线，从而保留常见CNV信号。我们使用含和不含扩增偏差的模拟以及恶性疟原虫、人乳腺癌和黑色素瘤数据集评估了GapCNV。在模拟中，GapCNV实现了高精确率同

extra.description: Copy number variants (CNVs) are prevalent in both diploid and haploid genomes and contribute to genome evolution and phenotypic diversity. However, CNV detection in low-input data, including low-cell and single-cell sequencing data, remains challenging due to the shallow and highly uneven read counts and amplification bias. Another challenge lies in selecting reference samples, which are used to provide a baseline for defining copy-number losses or gains. Normalization using references containing common CNVs can lead to cancellation of true CNV signals or false CNV calls. Here, we develop GapCNV, a statistical framework for CNV detection in low-input DNA sequencing data from both haploid and diploid genomes. GapCNV uses preliminary cell clustering and shared CNV profiles to construct bin-specific pseudo-references from cells inferred to have the copy-neutral state. This strategy reduces the incorporation of common CNVs into the normalization baseline and thereby preserves common CNV signals. We evaluated GapCNV using simulations with and without amplification biases and datasets from Plasmodium falciparum , human breast cancer and melanoma. In simulations, GapCNV achieved high precision rate while maintaining competitive sensitivity, with advantages for detecting short and common CNVs. In P. falciparum , GapCNV detected the known CNVs and recovered the short CNV more frequently than the benchmarking methods. In the melanoma cell line and human breast tumors, GapCNV recovered bulk or single-cell derived copy number profile across individual cells. These results show that adaptive, bin-specific pseudo-reference construction can improve CNV detection when reliable normal controls are unavailable.

items.summary_zh: 摘要 通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探索肿瘤微环境（TME）内的细胞异质性，对于理解癌症进展和治疗反应至关重要。然而，当前scRNA-seq方法缺乏空间背景，并依赖不完整的配体—受体相互作用数据集，限制了准确的细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞通讯推断。本研究使用一种新型图神经网络模型应对这些挑战，增强细胞类型预测和细胞相互作用分析。我们的研究使用了来自19名患者、三种癌症类型（白血病、乳腺浸润性癌和结直肠癌）的49 024个细胞组成的数据集。所提出的scGSL模型表现出稳健性能，在所有数据集上平均准确率为84.83%，精确率为86.23%，召回率为81.51%，F1分数为80.92%。这些指标相较现有方法有显著提升，后者通常表现出较低的性能指标。此外，通过回顾现有关于TME内基因相互作用的文献，scGSL模型被证明能以无监督方式稳健识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用，并通过多种癌症中关键

extra.description: Abstract The exploration of cellular heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment (TME) via single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is essential for understanding cancer progression and response to therapy. Current scRNA-seq approaches, however, lack spatial context and rely on incomplete datasets of ligand–receptor interactions, limiting accurate cell type annotation and cell–cell communication inference. This study addresses these challenges using a novel graph neural network model that enhances cell-type prediction and cell-interaction analysis. Our study utilized a dataset consisting of 49 024 cells from 19 patients across three cancer types: leukemia, breast invasive carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. The proposed scGSL model demonstrated robust performance, achieving an average accuracy of 84.83%, precision of 86.23%, recall of 81.51%, and an F1 score of 80.92% across all datasets. These metrics represent a significant enhancement over existing methods, which typically exhibit lower performance metrics. Additionally, by reviewing existing literature on gene interactions within the TME, the scGSL model proves to robustly identify biologically meaningful gene interactions in an unsupervised manner, validated by significant expression differences in key gene pairs across various cancers. The source code and data used in this study can be found at https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGSL.

items.title: CellStressDB: an AI-powered database of cellular responses to physical stressors
items.title_zh: CellStressDB：一个AI驱动的细胞对物理应激源反应数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 物理应激源通过触发协调的应激反应程序深刻影响细胞行为，这些程序调节信号传导、基因表达、代谢和细胞命运。在此，我们展示CellStressDB（https://cellstressdb.omic.tech），一个AI驱动的数据库，用于探索细胞对物理应激源的反应。当前版本包含来自131项转录组研究的数据，涵盖人类和小鼠九个物理应激类别和21个组织类别的2,364,816个细胞和1205个批量样本观察。数据和分析被组织为2848个索引分析条目，跨越71个规范物种-组织-应激背景，并保留详细暴露条件。CellStressDB通过22个组织感知分类器提供本体引导的细胞类型注释，并整合941个Geneformer检查点用于上下文特定的计算机扰动。分析包括应激反应程序、差异基因表达、功能富集、调节子活性、细胞类型组成和细胞间通讯（如适用），以及候选化合物优先级排序、可下载数据集和模型，以及用户提供

extra.description: Abstract Physical stressors profoundly influence cellular behavior by triggering coordinated stress-response programs that regulate signaling, gene expression, metabolism, and cell fate. Here, we present CellStressDB (https://cellstressdb.omic.tech), an AI-powered database for exploring cellular responses to physical stressors. The current release contains data from 131 transcriptomic studies, with 2 364 816 cell and 1205 bulk sample observations from human and mouse across nine physical-stress classes and 21 tissue categories. Data and analyses are organized into 2848 indexed analysis entries across 71 canonical species-tissue-stress contexts with detailed exposure conditions retained. CellStressDB provides ontology-guided cell-type annotation through 22 tissue-aware classifiers and incorporates 941 Geneformer checkpoints for context-specific in silico perturbation. Analyses include stress-response programs, differential gene expression, functional enrichment, regulon activity, cell-type composition, and cell–cell communication where applicable, with candidate compound prioritization, downloadable datasets and models, and analysis of user-provided transcriptomic data. Annotation evaluation and known-factor recovery analyses indicated context-dependent performance and coverage across biological settings. The mouse radiation-intestine example identifies Stat1 as a candidate regulator of radiation-induced intestinal injury supported by independent experimental evidence. Overall, CellStressDB provides an integrated, AI-enabled framework for exploring and interpreting cellular responses to physical stressors and generating testable hypotheses.

items.title: CROST 2.0: an expanded repository of spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: CROST 2.0：扩展的空间转录组学资源库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 CROST（https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost）是一个公共空间转录组学资源，提供精选数据集、标准化分析结果、结构化空间知识和交互式探索工具。在2.0版本中，我们的集合扩展到544个项目和3538个样本，较1.0版本（182个项目和1033个样本）增长近三倍。我们还大幅扩展了空间共定位和空间可变癌症基因的衍生资源。为促进空间微环境分析，CROST 2.0引入了一个分析框架，包括 niche相关差异表达、空间分辨基因集活性分析、空间相互作用热点和主题分析，以及分子和细胞类型niche分析。CROST 2.0还提供Spatial Compare功能，用于比较样本间的空间基因表达、细胞类型分布和niche组成。它引入了Cancer NicheDE模块以系统表征癌症niche相关差异表达，并整合了在线细胞类型注释工具SCType，使单细胞参考信息可用于空间转录组分析。这

extra.description: Abstract CROST (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/crost) is a public spatial transcriptomics resource that offers curated datasets, standardized analytical results, structured spatial knowledge, and interactive exploration tools. In version 2.0, our collection has expanded to 544 projects and 3538 samples, nearly a three-fold increase from version 1.0 (182 projects and 1033 samples). We have also substantially expanded the derived resources for spatial colocalization and spatially variable cancer genes. To facilitate spatial microenvironment analysis, CROST 2.0 introduces an analytical framework comprising niche-associated differential expression, spatially resolved gene-set activity analysis, spatial interaction hotspot and topic analyses, and molecular and cell-type niche analysis. CROST 2.0 also provides the Spatial Compare function to compare spatial gene expression, cell-type distributions, and niche composition across samples. It introduces the Cancer NicheDE module to systematically characterize cancer niche-associated differential expression and integrates an online cell-type annotation tool, SCType, enabling the use of single-cell reference information in spatial transcriptomic analysis. These updates extend CROST into an integrated spatial transcriptomics resource for characterizing spatial microenvironments, investigating cancer-associated spatial features, and comparing spatial patterns across samples.

items.title: GLAlign integrates single-cell multi-omics data via global manifold and local marker gene alignment
items.title_zh: GLAlign通过全局流形和局部标记基因比对整合单细胞多组学数据
items.summary_zh: 摘要 整合异质单细胞多组学数据集仍然具有挑战性，因为不同模态在 distinct 特征空间中测量，且缺乏细胞水平配对。现有流形比对或特征转换框架常受弱跨模态关联、几何模糊和过度校正影响。在此，我们提出GLAlign（全局流形和局部标记基因比对），这是一个优化框架，联合利用全局流形结构和局部标记基因信息来整合单细胞多组学数据。GLAlign通过由最大均值差异、失真和惩罚项组成的全局目标，以及由独立推断簇之间跨模态标记基因重叠引导的局部对比三元组损失，学习共享潜在空间。我们展示了GLAlign的方法学贡献，即通过生物学信息先验扩展流形比对，以确保几何上合理且生物学上正确的比对，而无需配对细胞或人工细胞类型注释。我们在模拟数据和真实数据集上评估了GLAlign，涵盖PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq、小鼠脑SNARE-seq、单供者和多批次CITE-seq，以及NCI-N87 s

extra.description: Abstract Integrating heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics datasets remains challenging because different modalities are measured in distinct feature spaces and lack cell level pairing. Existing manifold alignment or feature conversion framework are often affected by weak cross-modality associations, geometric ambiguity, and overcorrection. Here we present GLAlign (Global manifold and Local marker gene Alignment), an optimization framework that jointly leverages global manifold structure and local marker gene information to integrate single-cell multi-omics data. GLAlign learns a shared latent space through a global objective comprising maximum mean discrepancy, distortion, and penalty terms, together with a local contrastive triplet loss guided by cross-modality marker gene overlap between independently inferred clusters. We demonstrate GLAlign’s methodological contribution in extending the manifold alignment by biologically informed prior to ensure geometrically plausible and biologically correct alignments without requiring paired cells or manual cell type annotations. We evaluated GLAlign on simulated data and real datasets spanning PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq, mouse brain SNARE-seq, single-donor and multi-batch CITE-seq, and NCI-N87 scDNA-seq/scRNA-seq integration. Across the evaluated datasets, GLAlign achieved strong modality mixing and biological conservation, remained stable under moderate cell type imbalance and variations in clustering and marker information, and supported cross-modality label transfer and paired cell recovery. These results demonstrate that biologically structured coupling of global and local alignment provides an interpretable framework for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics integration. GLAlign is freely available at https://github.com/Bateer-Bio/GLAlign.

items.title: HGMetaADR: a multimodal heterogeneous graph meta-learning framework for generalized adverse drug reaction prediction
items.title_zh: HGMetaADR：用于广义药物不良反应预测的多模态异质图元学习框架
items.summary_zh: 摘要 早期识别药物不良反应（ADR），即正常剂量用药后出现的有害或非预期反应，对于减少临床试验失败和相关经济成本至关重要。然而，现有ADR数据集常呈现长尾标签分布，且稀有副作用缺乏足够训练样本，使普通监督学习模型难以泛化到代表性不足的类别。为解决这些问题，我们提出HGMetaADR，一种用于ADR预测的新型基于异质图的元学习框架。该方法构建在多模态生物医学知识图上，整合互补的药物相关数据，包括分子结构、蛋白质序列、副作用和治疗适应症。它采用分层注意力机制捕捉异质实体间的语义依赖，并采用模型无关的元学习策略增强对小样本类别的适应能力。我们在少样本、零样本和多数三种情景下评估HGMetaADR，以模拟真实世界条件。大量实验表明，HGMetaADR始终优于最先进基线。此外，消融研究和通路富集分析揭示了连接蛋白质靶点、治疗适应症和副作用的潜在生物学机制，从而验证了将异质生物医学知识纳入ADR建模的

extra.description: Abstract Early identification of adverse drug reactions (ADRs), which refer to harmful or unintended responses to medications taken at normal doses, is crucial for reducing clinical trial failures and associated economic costs. However, existing ADR datasets often exhibit a long-tailed label distribution and lack sufficient training examples for rare side effects, making it difficult for vanilla supervised learning models to generalize to underrepresented classes. To address these issues, we propose HGMetaADR, a novel heterogeneous graph-based meta-learning framework for ADR prediction. Built upon a multimodal biomedical knowledge graph, this approach integrates complementary drug-related data, including molecular structures, protein sequences, side effects, and therapeutic indications. It employs a hierarchical attention mechanism to capture semantic dependencies across heterogeneous entities and adopts a model-agnostic meta-learning strategy to enhance adaptation to small-sample classes. We evaluate HGMetaADR under three scenarios—few-shot, zero-shot, and majority—to simulate real-world conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HGMetaADR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, ablation studies and pathway enrichment analyses reveal the underlying biological mechanisms linking protein targets, therapeutic indications, and side effects, thereby validating the effectiveness of incorporating heterogeneous biomedical knowledge into ADR modeling.

items.title: GI-DB: a comprehensive variant database for exploring the extensive genetic diversity of the Indian population
items.title_zh: GI-DB：一个用于探索印度人群广泛遗传多样性的综合变异数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 印度人群以广泛的民族语言和生物地理多样性为特征，在全球基因组资源中代表性严重不足，限制了南亚基因组医学的发展。为解决这一问题，作为GenomeIndia计划（印度政府生物技术部）的一部分，对来自83个人群的约10,000个基因组进行了测序。在此，我们展示GI-DB（访问地址：https://ibdc.dbt.gov.in/gidb/），这是一个公共资源，收录了1.36亿个高置信度变异，其中包括4400万个不存在于其他全球和南亚数据库中的变异。GI-DB作为印度各人群遗传变异的群体特异性参考资源。它可支持罕见病、复杂疾病和药物基因组学中临床相关变异的解读。该数据库的结构提供部落和非部落群体、生物地理和民族语言类别的等位基因频率分层。交互式浏览器便于探索感兴趣的变异和基因，提供来自VEP、ClinVar等工具的详细注释，以及与1000 Genomes、gnomAD和GenomeAsia等

extra.description: Abstract The Indian population, characterized by extensive ethnolinguistic and biogeographical diversity, is significantly underrepresented in global genomic resources limiting the development of genomic medicine in South Asia. To address this, ~10 000 genomes from 83 populations were sequenced as part of the GenomeIndia initiative (Department of Biotechnology, Government of India). Here, we present GI-DB (accessible at https://ibdc.dbt.gov.in/gidb/), a public resource cataloging 136 million high-confidence variants, including 44 million variants which are not present in other global and South Asian databases. GI-DB serves as a population-specific reference resource for genetic variation across Indian populations. It can support the interpretation of clinically relevant variations for rare disease, complex disorders, and pharmacogenomics. The database is structured to provide allele frequency stratification across tribal and non-tribal groups, biogeography, and ethnolinguistic categories. The interactive browser facilitates exploration of variants and genes of interest, offering detailed annotations from tools like VEP, ClinVar, and comparisons with global databases like 1000 Genomes, gnomAD, and GenomeAsia. Researchers can search using different modalities and access data programmatically. GI-DB is a foundational resource for genomics-informed public health and clinical genetics, tailored for the Indian population.

items.title: RNAcomp2D: a web tool to execute multiple methods and visually compare predictions of RNA secondary structure.
items.title_zh: RNAcomp2D：一个网页工具，可执行多种方法并可视化比较RNA二级结构预测。
items.summary_zh: 核糖核酸（RNA）参与许多重要生物学过程。特别是非编码RNA是细胞过程的关键调控者，在基因表达中发挥重要作用。RNA二级结构是推断其特定功能以及理解其如何与其他分子相互作用的关键。过去十年已开发出许多计算模型来预测二级结构，成功率越来越高。然而，每种新方法都有自己的输入输出接口、编程语言、计算需求，有时还有专门的服务器来运行模型，或者只是仓库中的源代码。因此，如今很难从多种方法获得预测并一次性比较它们。迫切需要统一接口，允许同时访问多种方法、可视化和比较预测结果，并在有参考结构时也与之比较。我们在此介绍RNAcomp2D，一个基于网页的工具，用户可输入RNA序列或从RNAcentral选择一条，并使用多种最先进方法获得RNA二级结构预测。经典热力学方法和最新深度学习模型都打包在容器中，可在统一网站上访问。所有预测以及可用的参考结构都在单一图形界面中同时显示。此外，随着新模型不断开发，该工具

extra.description: Ribonucleic acids (RNAs) are involved in many important biological processes. In particular, non-coding RNAs are crucial regulators of cellular processes, playing a significant role in gene expression. RNA secondary structure is key to infer their specific function and for understanding how they interact with other molecules. Many computational models have been developed in the last decade to predict the secondary structure, achieving increasingly higher success rates. However, each new method has its own input-output interface, programming language, computational requirements and, sometimes, a dedicated server to run the model or just a source code in a repository. Thus, nowadays it is very hard to obtain predictions from multiple methods and compare them at once. A unified interface is urgently needed, which allows accessing several methods at the same time, visualizing and comparing predictions among them, and also with a reference structure when available. We introduce here RNAcomp2D, a web-based tool that allows users to enter an RNA sequence, or select one from RNAcentral, and obtain predictions of RNA secondary structures using several state-of-the-art methods. Both classical thermodynamic methods and the latest deep learning models are packaged in containers and accessible in an unified website. All the predictions, and the reference structure if available, are shown at the same time in a single graphical interface. Moreover, as new models continue to be developed, this tool is designed to be scalable, allowing the addition of more prediction methods in the future. Web server is available at https://sinc.unl.edu.ar/web-demo/rnacomp2d/. Data and source code are available at https://github.com/sinc-lab/RNAcomp2D. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: DriverDBv5: a multi-omics integration database for cancer driver gene research
items.title_zh: DriverDBv5：一个用于癌症驱动基因研究的多组学整合数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 癌症由多个分子层面的改变驱动，但多组学驱动因素是否具有预后权重尚未得到系统关注。DriverDBv5（https://driverdb.bioinfomics.org/）将DriverDB从驱动因素识别扩展到预后评估。它已扩展到187个队列、43,862名患者和129,655个样本，其中154个队列来自非TCGA（癌症基因组图谱）存储库，通过广义多组学条形码进行协调。驱动基因可通过Cox和混合治愈模型评估，可在完整多组学特征矩阵上进行机器学习，并可评估两个组学层面改变的联合预后效应。定制分析模块从4个工具增长到10个，用于用户定义的基因集、亚组和协变量，人体图谱提供解剖学入口。因此，DriverDBv5不仅揭示哪些改变驱动肿瘤，还揭示其中哪些与患者结局相关。

extra.description: Abstract Cancer is driven by alterations across multiple molecular layers, but whether multi-omics drivers carry prognostic weight has received little systematic attention. DriverDBv5 (https://driverdb.bioinfomics.org/) extends DriverDB from driver identification to prognostic evaluation. It has been expanded to 187 cohorts, 43 862 patients, and 129 655 samples, with 154 cohorts from non-TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas) repositories reconciled by a generalized multi-omics barcode. Driver genes can be evaluated with Cox and mixture cure models, with machine learning on the full multi-omics feature matrix, and for the joint prognostic effect of alterations in two omics layers. The Customized Analysis module has grown from 4 to 10 tools for user-defined gene sets, subgroups, and covariates, and a human body map offers an anatomical entry point. DriverDBv5 thus reveals not only which alterations drive a tumor, but also which of them relate to patient outcome.

items.title: AnnST: robust cross-section tissue domain label transfer in spatial transcriptomics via contrastive learning and optimal transport
items.title_zh: AnnST：通过对比学习和最优传输在空间转录组学中实现稳健的跨切片组织域标签转移

items.title: ASAOT: an accentuated structure-differentiated asymmetric optimal transport model for cell type and single-cell spatial mapping
items.title_zh: ASAOT：一种用于细胞类型和单细胞空间映射的增强结构差异化非对称最优传输模型
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学（STs）表征时空基因表达，并促进对组织微环境中细胞结构和细胞间通讯的分析。然而，现有空间解卷积方法采用全局固定平滑而无局部锐化，这会模糊细胞边界并阻碍脑组织中分层、异质性细胞模式的重建。在此，我们提出增强结构差异化非对称最优传输（ASAOT），一个基于结构增强非对称最优传输的解卷积框架。结合空间邻域约束，ASAOT引入差异化增强锐化项以维持全局空间连续性、增强边界检测并保留斑点级表达异质性。利用非对称最优传输，该框架联合估计斑点级细胞类型比例并对参考单细胞坐标进行空间分配。在多种模拟数据集上的基准测试表明，ASAOT在中等空间分辨率下实现了有竞争力的整体准确性和稳健性，在测试方法中平均综合排名最佳。应用于小鼠嗅球和大脑皮层数据集表明，ASAOT减少了信号扩散和边界失真，有效恢复分层脑解剖结构和分层细胞分布，从而构建参考单细胞图谱的可解释空间图。总体而言，ASAOT通过锐

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (STs) characterizes spatiotemporal gene expression and facilitates analysis of cellular architecture and cell–cell crosstalk within tissue microenvironments. However, existing spatial deconvolution methods employ globally fixed smoothing without local sharpening, which blurs cellular boundaries and impedes reconstruction of layered, heterogeneous cellular patterns in brain tissue. Here, we present Accentuated Structure-differentiated Asymmetric Optimal Transport (ASAOT), a deconvolution framework built on structure-enhanced asymmetric optimal transport. Coupled with spatial neighborhood constraints, ASAOT introduces a differentiated accentuated sharpening term to maintain global spatial continuity, enhance boundary detection, and preserve spot-level expression heterogeneity. Using asymmetric optimal transport, the framework jointly estimates spot-wise cell-type proportions and performs spatial assignment of reference single-cell coordinates. Benchmarks on diverse simulated datasets demonstrate that ASAOT achieves competitive overall accuracy and robustness across moderate spatial resolutions, with the best average comprehensive rank among tested methods. Applications to mouse olfactory bulb and cerebral cortex datasets demonstrate that ASAOT reduces signal diffusion and boundary distortion, effectively recovering layered brain anatomy and stratified cell distributions to build interpretable spatial maps of reference single-cell profiles. Collectively, ASAOT addresses critical drawbacks of conventional methods via a sharpening regularization term, serving as a reliable tool for STs analysis and mechanism exploration of tissue spatial organization.

items.title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spOT-NMF：通过最优传输与邻近感知生态位映射进行基因表达反卷积用于空间转录组学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够直接分析完整组织内的细胞组织，然而两个挑战限制了其充分利用：混合表达信号（包括异种移植等物种混合模型）的准确无参考反卷积，以及缺乏能将每个斑点的程序使用值转化为空间生态位的工具。我们开发了spOT-NMF，一种基于最优传输的非负矩阵分解方法，用Wasserstein距离替代标准重建损失，无需匹配的单细胞图谱即可解开混合信号。虽然广义OT-NMF分解适用于任何表达矩阵，但基于邻近性的生态位推断模块进一步将空间转录组中的程序共使用转化为定义组织区室及其边界的方向共现网络。在涵盖亚细胞到多细胞分辨率、多个平台和两种物种混合场景的五个金标准数据集上进行基准测试，spOT-NMF在无参考方法中排名第一，在异种移植特有的信号不平衡条件下尤其具有优势。我们表明无参考反卷积能够恢复匹配单细胞图谱中缺失的细胞群体，突显了无监督分析的价值。应用于胶质母细胞瘤异种移植和人类结直肠癌，spO

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches. We developed spOT-NMF, an optimal transport-based non-negative matrix factorization method that replaces standard reconstruction loss with the Wasserstein distance to disentangle mixed signals without requiring matched single-cell atlases. While the generalized OT-NMF factorization is applicable to any expression matrix, a proximity-based niche inference module further translates program co-usage from spatial transcriptomes into directional co-occurrence networks that define tissue compartments and their boundaries. Benchmarking across five gold-standard datasets spanning sub-cellular to multi-cellular resolutions, multiple platforms, and two-species admixture scenarios, spOT-NMF ranks first among reference-free methods, with particular advantage under the signal imbalance conditions characteristic of xenografts. We show that reference-free deconvolution recovers cell populations absent from matched single-cell atlases, highlighting the value of unsupervised analysis. Applied to glioblastoma xenografts and human colorectal cancer, spOT-NMF reveals spatially restricted interferon signaling, invasion routes, and CAF–tumor boundaries. spOT-NMF is available as an open-source Python package with GPU, CPU, and HPC support.

items.title: Identifying multi-omics spatial domains via masked autoencoder and diffusion-based latent regularization with SpaMEDM
items.title_zh: 通过掩码自编码器和基于扩散的潜在正则化与SpaMEDM识别多组学空间域
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间多组学数据提供了组织组织的互补分子视图。然而，由于数据稀疏性、技术噪声和模态特异性分布，其整合仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了空间掩码自编码器和基于扩散的模型（SpaMEDM），一个端到端图表示学习框架，它增强了双注意力图整合骨干，并加入了掩码重建和基于扩散的潜在噪声预测正则化。在掩码轨道中，通过利用模态和图特定的邻域信息来恢复随机掩码的斑点特征。同时，在随机采样的噪声水平下对模态特定的潜在表示施加高斯扰动，并训练一个空间图信息网络来预测注入的噪声。这种基于扩散的目标仅在训练期间使用，以鼓励对潜在扰动的鲁棒性，而不是在推理期间执行迭代反向扩散或采样。此外，基于余弦的配对斑点方向对齐和邻接重建鼓励兼容的跨模态表示并保留所选图结构。SpaMEDM灵活支持纯空间、双特征-空间和模态特定特征修剪的空间图配置。在不同空间多组学数据集上的评估展示了有竞争力的空间域识别性能，并产生促进下游探

extra.description: Abstract Spatial multi-omics data provide complementary molecular views of tissue organization. However, their integration remains challenging due to data sparsity, technical noise, and modality-specific distributions. Here, we present Spatial Masked autoEncoder and Diffusion-based Model (SpaMEDM), an end-to-end graph representation learning framework that augments a dual-attention graph-integration backbone with masked reconstruction and diffusion-based latent noise-prediction regularization. In the masked track, randomly masked spot features are recovered by leveraging modality- and graph-specific neighborhood information. In parallel, Gaussian perturbations are applied to modality-specific latent representations at randomly sampled noise levels, and a spatial-graph-informed network is trained to predict the injected noise. This diffusion-based objective is used exclusively during training to encourage robustness to latent perturbations, rather than to perform iterative reverse diffusion or sampling during inference. Furthermore, cosine-based paired-spot directional alignment and adjacency reconstruction encourage compatible cross-modality representations and preservation of the selected graph structure. SpaMEDM flexibly supports purely spatial, dual feature–spatial, and modality-specific feature-pruned spatial graph configurations. Evaluations across diverse spatial multi-omics datasets demonstrate competitive spatial-domain identification performance and produce integrated embeddings that facilitate downstream exploratory analyses.

items.title: Structured multi-view relational learning for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: 用于药物反应预测的结构化多视图关系学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 药物反应预测（DRP）需要能够联合表征分子药物结构和异质细胞状态的模型。尽管近期深度学习方法已将多组学图谱与药物表征整合，但许多方法将组学视图视为并行特征来源或在关系建模前将其合并，这可能削弱组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。在此，我们提出MulDR，一个结构化多视图关系学习框架，在药物条件化的细胞–药物交互之前保留组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。MulDR为通路活性、基因表达、突变和DNA甲基化构建独立的关系结构，学习视图特异的关系细胞表征，并使用互补的基序级、几何感知分子图和Morgan指纹药物表征来条件化其融合。通过这种设计，细胞系相似性在交互阶段之前保持视图依赖，而非被过早压缩为单一特征或关系空间。大量实验表明，MulDR在相同评估协议下持续优于代表性和近期基线，相对于最强基线将均方根误差降低6.07%。对未见药物和细胞系的冷启动评估进一步表明MulDR能泛化到先前未见的实体，而消

extra.description: Abstract Drug response prediction (DRP) requires models that jointly characterize molecular drug structure and heterogeneous cellular states. Although recent deep learning approaches have integrated multi-omics profiles with drug representations, many treat omics views as parallel feature sources or merge them before relational modeling, which can weaken omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures. Here, we propose MulDR, a structured multi-view relational learning framework that preserves omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures before drug-conditioned cell–drug interaction. MulDR constructs separate relation structures for pathway activity, gene expression, mutation, and DNA methylation, learns view-specific relational cell representations, and uses complementary motif-level, geometry-aware molecular graph, and Morgan fingerprint drug representations to condition their fusion. With this design, cell-line similarity remains view-dependent until the interaction stage, rather than being prematurely compressed into a single feature or relation space. Extensive experiments show that MulDR consistently outperforms representative and recent baselines under the same evaluation protocol, reducing root mean square error by 6.07% relative to the strongest baseline. Cold-start evaluations on unseen drugs and cell lines further show that MulDR generalizes to previously unseen entities, while ablation studies show that removing either view-specific relational modeling or drug-conditioned fusion consistently compromises predictive performance. Together, these results suggest that preserving omics-specific cell-line relations before drug-conditioned interaction modeling provides an effective strategy for robust DRP.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合在模态不完整下的多组学生存预测
items.summary_zh: 摘要 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，然而模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点之间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按每个模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集上稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，而仅七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Abstract Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: velotest: statistical assessment of RNA velocity embeddings reveals quality differences for reliable trajectory visualizations.
items.title_zh: velotest：RNA速度嵌入的统计评估揭示质量差异，以实现可靠轨迹可视化。
items.summary_zh: 当代单细胞RNA测序研究通常使用RNA速度分析研究细胞动态。通常，RNA速度通过二维投影评估。尽管已知基因表达数据的非线性嵌入无法跨尺度全面保留原始高维数据结构，但没有工具系统评估和量化速度嵌入的忠实度。这种情况可能导致误导性的速度可视化和假定的细胞状态转换。为此，我们推出velotest，一种细胞级统计检验，量化速度嵌入相对于其高维对应物的忠实度。在多个数据集和嵌入方法上应用velotest，我们发现嵌入方法、数据集以及单个数据集内区域之间的嵌入质量存在强烈差异。因此，velotest提供了必要的验证步骤，使研究人员能够选择合适的高维速度可视化，确保从速度投影得出的假设建立在准确表示的动态之上。

extra.description: Contemporary single-cell RNA-sequencing studies typically use RNA velocity analyses to investigate cellular dynamics. Commonly, RNA velocities are assessed with two-dimensional projections. Although it is well established that nonlinear embeddings of gene expression data cannot comprehensively preserve the structure of the original high-dimensional data across scales, there is no tool that systematically assesses and quantifies the faithfulness of velocity embeddings. This situation potentially leads to misleading velocity visualizations and putative cell state transitions. To this end, we introduce velotest, a cell-level statistical test that quantifies the faithfulness of a velocity embedding with respect to its high-dimensional counterpart. Applying velotest across multiple datasets and embedding methods, we find strong differences in the embedding qualities between embedding methods, datasets, and regions in individual datasets. velotest thus provides an essential validation step and enables researchers to select a suitable visualization of high-dimensional velocities, ensuring that hypotheses drawn from velocity projections are grounded in accurately represented dynamics.

items.title: pyGENIE: A Python library for programmatic access and mutational analysis of AACR Project GENIE.
items.title_zh: pyGENIE：一个用于程序化访问和突变分析AACR Project GENIE的Python库。
items.summary_zh: 截至目前，AACR Project GENIE自2015年启动以来已完成19次数据发布。最新发布包括来自近25万名患者的超过268 000个样本，截至2026年2月，已有超过1730篇科学期刊文章引用了Project GENIE数据。尽管其规模和科学影响巨大，对GENIE数据的程序化分析通常仍要求研究人员直接处理复杂的平面文件并开发自定义数据整合工作流。我们在此介绍pyGENIE，一个Python包，提供统一API用于访问GENIE平面文件、执行临床和基因组查询、计算肿瘤突变负荷，并与领先的突变特征分析工具（包括SigProfiler和SigMA）集成。遵循数据即服务范式，pyGENIE将所有结果返回为原生pandas DataFrame，可与机器学习和可视化库无缝集成。应用于肺腺癌（LUAD）案例研究，pyGENIE重现了已知突变频率、共突变模式和突变特征，同时将所需代码库减少约一个数量

extra.description: As of today, AACR Project GENIE has completed 19 data releases since its launch in 2015. The latest release includes more than 268 000 samples from nearly 250 000 patients, and as of February 2026, over 1730 scientific journal articles have cited Project GENIE data. Despite its scale and scientific impact, programmatic analysis of GENIE data often still requires researchers to work directly with complex flat files and develop custom data integration workflows. Here we present pyGENIE, a Python package that provides a unified API for accessing GENIE flat files, performing clinical and genomic queries, computing tumor mutational burden, and integrating with leading mutational signature analysis tools including SigProfiler and SigMA. Following a data-as-a-service paradigm, pyGENIE returns all results as native pandas DataFrames, enabling seamless integration with machine learning and visualization libraries. Applied to a lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) case study, pyGENIE reproduces known mutation frequencies, co-mutation patterns, and mutational signatures while reducing the required codebase by approximately an order of magnitude. pyGENIE is freely available at https://github.com/gersteinlab/pyGENIE under the MIT License, archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21981945, and can be installed from PyPI using pip install pygenie-sdk. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: ABAQS: A comprehensive scoring method for assessing genome annotation quality.
items.title_zh: ABAQS：一种评估基因组注释质量的综合评分方法。
items.summary_zh: 随着基因组资源持续扩展，估计基因组注释（例如基因和蛋白质模型）的准确性和完整性对于确保下游分析和应用的质量变得至关重要。在比较基因组分析中，选择具有可比组装和注释质量的基因组变得关键。若不仔细审查，注释质量的不一致可能损害下游研究。我们开发了基于准确性的注释质量评分（ABAQS），一种全面评估基因组注释质量的新方法。ABAQS评估多个因素，包括基因组完整性、基因模型有效性和蛋白质谱准确性，比BUSCO和PSAURON等指标提供更完整的注释质量图景。我们将ABAQS应用于1700多个真核真菌和藻类基因组，展示了其在评估基因组注释质量方面的稳健性和有效性，使其成为处理基因组数据的研究人员的宝贵工具。ABAQS软件见https://github.com/mycocosm-lbl/abaqs。它需要Java SDK版本>=21和Maven。我们还在DockerHub上提供Docker镜像。补充数据

extra.description: As genome resources continue to expand, estimating the accuracy and completeness of genome annotations (e.g., gene and protein models) becomes essential to ensure quality of downstream analyses and applications. It becomes critical in comparative genomic analysis to select genomes with comparable qualities of assembly and annotation. Without careful scrutiny, inconsistencies in annotation quality can undermine downstream studies. We have developed Accuracy-Based Annotation Quality Score (ABAQS), a novel method to comprehensively assess genome annotation quality. ABAQS evaluates multiple factors, including genome completeness, gene model validity, and protein profile accuracy, providing a more complete picture of annotation quality than metrics like BUSCO and PSAURON. We applied ABAQS to 1700+ eukaryotic fungal and algal genomes and showed its robustness and effectiveness in evaluating genome annotation quality, making it a valuable tool for researchers working with genomic data. ABAQS software is available at https://github.com/mycocosm-lbl/abaqs. It requires Java SDK version > =21 and Maven. We also provide a Docker image on DockerHub. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.title_zh: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.summary_zh: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法

extra.description: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法提出了一种基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。实验结果表明,该算法不仅能抵抗多种流量分析攻击,而且保证了一定的Tor电路性能。

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

extra.description: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法
items.title_zh: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: TH-FCAD：面向FPGA集群的大规模神经网络自动化部署框架
items.title_zh: TH-FCAD：面向FPGA集群的大规模神经网络自动化部署框架

extra.description:
<p<针对单颗FPGA资源受限难以加速大规模神经网络，且FPGA集群面临架构设计复杂、任务划分低效及自动化工具链缺失等挑战，提出面向FPGA集群的端到端自动化部署框架TH-FCAD（automated deployment framework for large-scale neural networks on FPGA clusters）。首先，构建基于TH-Express的2级互连集群架构，融合全局互连与局部互连，实现高带宽、低延迟的跨节点通信；其次，提出延迟平衡优化与模型切分方法，将大规模模型均匀切分为多加速核并保持核间延时均衡；最后，设计集群感知映射算法，联合FPGA资源约束与通信拓扑自动生成最优映射，以最小化通信开销。构建了完整的工具链，实现了从PyTorch/TensorFlow模型到集群的端到端自动化编译部署。基于16节点FPGA集群的评估表明，部署ResNet-8，SqueezeNet，ResNet-50时，推理延迟分别为0.051 ms，1.24 ms，1.36 ms，峰值算力达5.95 TOPS；较现有多FPGA方案性能提升28.4%，且优于CPU与GPU平台。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2788-2806.

items.title: 面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核
items.title_zh: 面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核
items.summary_zh: <p<近年来，稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘（SpMM）已成为科学计算、图处理和深度学习等多个领域的核心算子和制约系统性能的瓶颈。然而，现有通用GPU上的SpMM实现普遍存在能效比、资源利用率低的问题，而一些专用的加速器虽然在规则计算上展现出了优异的能效比，但缺乏对不规则的稀疏矩阵运算的高效支持。针对此问题，基于高通量数据流众核处理器（DFU），提出了一种面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核DFU-SpMM。首先提出数据流指令复用的分层稀疏矩阵处理方法，对稀疏数据进行重组织以减少SpMM内核的数据流图重传次数，同时，对于不同稀疏块使用不同的策略对其进行处理。然后提出面向流图优化的自适应汇编代码生成方法，引入观察者-执行者的思想，以突破现有DFU在SpMM内核生成方面的能力限制，并从任务分配和寄存器重用2个角度对代码生成过程中的数据流图构造进行优化。代表性数据集上的实验结果

extra.description:
<p<近年来，稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘（SpMM）已成为科学计算、图处理和深度学习等多个领域的核心算子和制约系统性能的瓶颈。然而，现有通用GPU上的SpMM实现普遍存在能效比、资源利用率低的问题，而一些专用的加速器虽然在规则计算上展现出了优异的能效比，但缺乏对不规则的稀疏矩阵运算的高效支持。针对此问题，基于高通量数据流众核处理器（DFU），提出了一种面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核DFU-SpMM。首先提出数据流指令复用的分层稀疏矩阵处理方法，对稀疏数据进行重组织以减少SpMM内核的数据流图重传次数，同时，对于不同稀疏块使用不同的策略对其进行处理。然后提出面向流图优化的自适应汇编代码生成方法，引入观察者-执行者的思想，以突破现有DFU在SpMM内核生成方面的能力限制，并从任务分配和寄存器重用2个角度对代码生成过程中的数据流图构造进行优化。代表性数据集上的实验结果表明：相较于RTX 4090 GPU环境下的现有前沿工作DTC-SpMM和HP-SpMM，DFU-SpMM分别提高了平均1.09倍与1.23倍的能效以及1.71倍与1.10倍的计算资源利用率；相较于DFU加速器上数据重组织前的SpMM内核，优化后的内核实现了1.41倍的性能提升以及1.51倍的能效比提升。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2807-2821.

items.title: Arm机密计算架构研究进展与展望
items.title_zh: Arm机密计算架构研究进展与展望
items.summary_zh: <p<随着云计算、大数据和人工智能的快速发展，数据安全与隐私保护已成为亟待解决的核心问题。2021年Arm提出机密计算架构（confidential compute architecture，CCA），通过硬件级隔离机制为敏感计算任务提供可信执行环境，保障数据与代码在使用过程中的安全性。尽管在用户态机密执行、设备隔离与系统安全增强等基于CCA的研究中已有初步成果，但整体来看，该领域仍处于起步阶段，现有研究较为分散，缺乏对架构发展与技术体系的系统性梳理。同时，部分研究重复构建底层关键机制，却未能总结技术共性。另一些工作则更关注功能实现，而对潜在攻击面及未来风险的分析不足。针对上述问题，对CCA在机密计算中的关键技术机制与研究进展进行系统分析，并对近年来具有代表性的成果进行分类归纳，涵盖执行环境扩展、设备隔离、应用适配与安全增强等方面的设计思路与实现路径。在此基础上

extra.description:
<p<随着云计算、大数据和人工智能的快速发展，数据安全与隐私保护已成为亟待解决的核心问题。2021年Arm提出机密计算架构（confidential compute architecture，CCA），通过硬件级隔离机制为敏感计算任务提供可信执行环境，保障数据与代码在使用过程中的安全性。尽管在用户态机密执行、设备隔离与系统安全增强等基于CCA的研究中已有初步成果，但整体来看，该领域仍处于起步阶段，现有研究较为分散，缺乏对架构发展与技术体系的系统性梳理。同时，部分研究重复构建底层关键机制，却未能总结技术共性。另一些工作则更关注功能实现，而对潜在攻击面及未来风险的分析不足。针对上述问题，对CCA在机密计算中的关键技术机制与研究进展进行系统分析，并对近年来具有代表性的成果进行分类归纳，涵盖执行环境扩展、设备隔离、应用适配与安全增强等方面的设计思路与实现路径。在此基础上，结合典型系统案例，凝练CCA研究中常用的技术路径，包含根世界隔离、多颗粒表内存隔离机制、2阶段页表与系统内存管理单元协同等关键技术。最后，进一步探讨当前CCA面临的主要挑战与研究趋势，为Arm机密计算领域的研究与创新提供参考。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2822-2842.

items.title: SCoT-SQL：一种基于思维链引导的Text-to-SQL数据合成方法
items.title_zh: SCoT-SQL：一种基于思维链引导的Text-to-SQL数据合成方法

extra.description:
<p<在Text-to-SQL任务中，模型通常需要大规模的标注数据进行训练，而标注这些数据往往耗费大量的时间和人力成本。因此，数据稀缺性成为制约该领域发展、尤其是在特定领域应用中的关键瓶颈。在此背景下，基于大语言模型（large language model，LLM）的数据增强虽已成为一种有效的解决方案，然而当前Text-to-SQL领域的大多数现有方法严重依赖于原始数据集的分布，且其合成的数据往往缺乏可靠性与可解释性。针对上述问题，提出了一种思维链引导的数据合成方法SCoT-SQL。通过整合自然语言指令与包括数据库模式及表内容在内的符号知识，有效指引大模型减少数据合成过程中的语义错误。为确保合成数据的高质量，SCoT-SQL结合了模型自一致性投票与执行验证机制来进行严格的数据过滤。此外，还引入了基于思维链推理的模型自反馈机制对合成数据进行校准，在修正SQL查询逻辑不一致的同时，补充了数据合成的分步推理轨迹，从而进一步增强了数据的可靠性与可解释性。在KaggleDBQA与ScienceBenchmark数据集上的实验表明，SCoT-SQL方法的执行准确率相较于之前最先进的数据合成方法分别提升了6.5个百分点与3个百分点，证明了其在低资源及复杂场景下的有效性。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2939-2951.

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。
